read.thesis: Jabil beat and raised FY26 revenue to $34B and core EPS to $12.25 on Intelligent Infrastructure demand; no capacity or capex commentary in the release, and the net cash outlay on acquisitions rose to $848M in six months.

triggers.label: FY26 core EPS guidance raised to $12.25
triggers.quote: we are raising our fiscal 2026 outlook for revenue and core EPS

triggers.label: Intelligent Infrastructure demand robust
triggers.quote: demand remains robust across cloud and data center infrastructure, networking and communications, and capital equipment

triggers.label: Acquisition spend $848M in six months
triggers.quote: Cash paid for business and intangible asset acquisitions, net of cash

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow weak vs core earnings
red_flags.quote: Change in operating assets and liabilities, exclusive of net assets acquired
